create_COCODataset: create a COCODataset instance from a COCO annotation file and image root directory
getitem_COCODataset: get an image and its bounding box labels masks and keypoints by index
has_valid_annotation: check if a list of COCO annotations contains valid bounding boxes or keypoints
get_img_info_COCODataset: get the COCO image metadata dictionary for a given dataset index
count_visible_keypoints: count the total number of visible keypoints across a list of COCO annotations
